priorities.title: Make paid report delivery recoverable and visible
priorities.user_problem: After paying, people cannot tell whether payment or the report is still in progress. Some abandon in pending, some wait minutes and think the app crashed, and some ask for their money back.
priorities.proposed_change: One purchase-status screen driven by the transaction state (pending → verified → preparing report → delivered / failed). Automatic delivery retry plus a 'Restore my report' action keyed on the transaction ID, so a retry can never create a second purchase. Pending purchases show what is happening and when they expire.
priorities.acceptance_pass: At cutoff in the next cohort: 0 verified payments without a delivered report, 0 purchases still pending, and no user with two charges for one report.
priorities.acceptance_fail: Any verified payment undelivered at cutoff, any purchase left pending without a visible state, or any duplicate charge after a retry.

priorities.title: Check device, permission and light before the scan, not during it
priorities.user_problem: People hit a dead end at the start: an unsupported phone, a camera-permission prompt before they see any value, or a scan that fails twice in low light.
priorities.proposed_change: Detect LiDAR support on first open and explain the requirement before onboarding; ask for camera permission only when the user taps 'Start scan' after seeing a sample result; detect low light before capture and show one concrete fix (turn on the main light, hold for 3 seconds).
priorities.acceptance_pass: In the next cohort the qualified → qualified scan rate is at or above the current baseline, and no research participant is blocked by device support, permission timing or light without a clear next step.
priorities.acceptance_fail: Qualified → qualified scan rate falls below the current baseline, or a participant again reaches an unexplained device or permission dead end.

priorities.title: Show what the paid guide contains, and its terms, before asking for payment
priorities.user_problem: People are asked to pay before they understand what the full report adds over the free suggestion, and one paid without understanding the subscription terms.
priorities.proposed_change: Paywall shows one real, partly locked section of the user's own guide, a one-line list of what unlocks, and the plain-language price and renewal terms next to the button.
priorities.acceptance_pass: Free suggestion → verified payer rate is not lower than the current baseline, and the share of verified purchases fully refunded is lower than the current baseline.
priorities.acceptance_fail: Payer rate drops below baseline, or the refund share does not fall.

experiment_cards.status_reason: Commercial delivery is not ready: given flag is false; 2 verified payments undelivered; 2 purchases pending. Draft only — not approved for launch.
experiment_cards.owner: Growth PM, ASO (name to be assigned before launch)
experiment_cards.channel: App Store custom product page, served to ASA_Category search ads
experiment_cards.target_problem: In ASA_Category traffic, 78% (14/18) of first opens reach a qualified scan and 25% (1/4) of verified purchases were fully refunded. experiment_cards.stop_rule: Stop when the $500.00 cap is spent or after 14 days. Stop early if any verified payment from this cohort stays undelivered for more than 24 hours, or if the refund share rises above 25% (1/4). If fewer than 20 first opens are reached (budget reach: ≈7 first opens at $66.67 cash each), report the result as inconclusive and make no rate claims.
experiment_cards.continue_rule: Roll the page out to all ASA traffic only if, with at least 20 first opens, qualified scans per impression beat the default page over the same period, qualified scan ÷ first open is at or above 78% (14/18), and no guardrail is breached.
